evidence_rules.index: Clarivate Master Journal List public search (mjl.clarivate.com), accessed 2026-11-24 in a browser. Publisher indexing lists used only where MJL was not checked.
evidence_rules.jif: Publisher journal page label 'Journal Impact Factor X (2025)'. JCR 2026 was released 2026-06-17 with 2025 data, so the 2025 JIF is the latest.
evidence_rules.quartile: LetPub public pages (secondary, edition not labelled). Treated as JCR 2026 because rank ties match the 2025 JIF ties: Computational Statistics and Statistical Methods & Applications both have JIF 1.3 and both rank 84/170; JIIS and Pattern Recognition Letters both have JIF 3.5 and both rank 102/210. Not checked in Clarivate JCR itself.
evidence_rules.first_decision: Springer: 'Submission to first decision (median)' on the journal page; includes desk rejections. Elsevier: 'Submission to first decision' on the journal insights page. Taylor & Francis: 'avg. days from submission to first decision', read from a search-engine copy of the page because the live page shows an interactive Cloudflare check that was not completed.
evidence_rules.accepted_paper_timing: Received-to-accepted days for the 20 most recent articles on link.springer.com/journal/<id>/articles, 2026-11-24. These are accepted papers only (survivors), not the journal's overall turnaround.
evidence_rules.fees: Springer how-to-publish-with-us page: 'Authors can also choose to publish under the subscription publishing model (no APC charges apply)'. Other mandatory charges are not fully certified.
evidence_rules.probabilities: Acceptance and desk-reject percentages in the report are Claude's subjective judgement, not calibrated estimates.
